query: CFC 1207.3.4 energy storage management system disconnect safe condition hazardous temperatures

results.query: CFC 1207.3.4 energy storage management system disconnect safe condition hazardous temperatures
results.snippet: The system shall disconnect electrical connections to the ESS or otherwise place it in a safe condition if potentially hazardous temperatures or other conditions such as short circuits, over voltage or under voltage are detected.
results.title: California Fire Code 2022, Chapter 12 Energy Systems, 1207.3.4 Energy Storage Management System
